title: Why a 43% Gender Gap Predicts Activity Inequality
hook: A 43% gender gap helps explain activity inequality worldwide.
closing: Health depends not just on average movement, but on who gets left behind.
question: Who gets fewer walking opportunities?

segments.say: Hong Kong averages 6,880 daily steps, showing how widely movement differs between countries.
High-inequality countries reach 297 on the obesity index, nearly tripling the low-inequality baseline.
The gender step gap explains 43 percent of activity inequality, revealing who is most often left behind.
